browseSight_features.title: Hover-to-Scan
browseSight_features.benefit: Instantly scans any link before you click it, keeping you safe from hidden threats.

browseSight_features.title: AI Security Analysis
browseSight_features.benefit: Uses advanced AI to explain why a site is dangerous in plain English, not technical jargon.

browseSight_features.title: Dangerous Site Blocker
browseSight_features.benefit: Automatically intercepts malicious links and stops you from visiting sites that steal data.

browseSight_features.title: Scam & Urgency Detection
browseSight_features.benefit: Highlights high-pressure selling tactics and fake 'limited time' offers that try to rush you into a mistake.

browseSight_features.title: Secure Form Guard
browseSight_features.benefit: Identifies if a login or payment form is insecure before you enter your private information.

browseSight_features.title: Lookalike Domain Protection
browseSight_features.benefit: Detects fake websites trying to impersonate brands like Google or Amazon.

browseSight_features.title: Intelligent Warnings
browseSight_features.benefit: Provides helpful security alerts for suspicious sites without getting in the way of your browsing.

browseSight_features.title: URL Unshortening
browseSight_features.benefit: Exposes the real destination of hidden links (like bit.ly) to detect threats before you're redirected.

browseSight_features.title: Custom Security Toggles
browseSight_features.benefit: Choose which security layers you want active (like Scam Detection or Form Guardian) directly from the popup.

browseSight_features.title: Instant Privacy Protection
browseSight_features.benefit: Ensures your scanning data is handled privately and provides instant verification for trusted sites like GitHub.
